card.name: Adjectives after "it is" before to-clause
card.fires_on: Evaluative words like hard, recommended, best or difficult right after "it is", "is not" or "makes it", where a to-clause or condition follows. Seen in technical and computing text.

modes.label: Hard/difficult
modes.description: The word hard or difficult describes how tough something is, followed by "to" or a failure term.
modes.example: why is this so<< hard>> to understand?

modes.label: Recommended/best
modes.description: A recommendation word after "it is" introduces advice about what to do.
modes.example: it is<< recommended>> that their certificates be removed and the books

modes.label: Other verbs
modes.description: A verb such as wear or lead appears after "to" or "should" in technical advice.
